name: relay-8
description: 8-channel 5 V SPDT relay expansion board for the ESP32-S3 controller family: PCA9554 I2C expander, AO3400A low-side drivers, 24C02 ID EEPROM, 1x6 expansion header.
notes: TOOLING PROOF, NOT A PRODUCTION-REVIEWED BOARD. Electrical doubts to resolve before fabrication: (1) Coil load is 8 x ~72 mA = ~576 mA at 5 V (plus ~3 mA per indicator LED) through a single 2.54 mm header pin and thin traces from the base board; check header pin current rating and the base board 5 V budget, or add a local 5 V input / bulk capacitance. (2) Expander is a PCA9554 (push-pull outputs, all inputs at power-up so relays stay off) rather than a PCF8574 (quasi-bidirectional, powers up with all pins high and only ~100 uA pull-up drive); it keeps the PCF8574 pinout and address range 0x20-0x27, A0-A2 tied low = 0x20. P0..P7 drive the gates via 100R; 100k pull-downs keep relays off while the expander is unpowered or in reset. (3) AO3400A (Vgs(th) ~0.65-1.45 V, low Rds(on) at 2.5 V) is fine at 3.3 V logic; the basic 2N7002 (C8545, 115 mA rated, higher Vth) would be marginal for a 72 mA coil at 3.3 V gate drive. (4) Flyback: 1N4148W across each coil is adequate for a 5 V coil; LED + 1k from 5 V to the switch node lights while the channel is on. (5) Contact rating (SRD: 10 A 250 VAC / 30 VDC) is NOT supported by this layout: trace widths, creepage/clearance between COM/NO/NC and logic, and slots under the relay for mains are not designed; do not use for mains as drawn. (6) Relay pin3/pin4 = NC/NO assignment and pad coordinates are copied from the KiCad SRD (Relay_SPDT_SANYOU_SRD_Series_Form_C) footprint convention re-centred on the body; verify against the Songle datasheet bottom view. (7) I2C: EEPROM fixed at 0x50 (A0-A2 and WP low, so writable), expander at 0x20; 4.7k SDA/SCL pull-ups are fitted here but should be DNP if the base board already pulls up. INT is open-drain with no pull-up on this board; the base board must supply one. (8) Header: 1x6, pins V5, V3_3, GND, SDA, SCL, INT. Bottom-layer GND copper pour. Parts are JLCPCB/LCSC numbers; only 0603 passives, 0805 10 uF, 1N4148W and the 0603 LED are basic; relay, terminals, expander, EEPROM, AO3400A and header are extended.
